statement: If a nonprojective compact irreducible hyperkähler manifold Z of complex dimension 2n contains a holomorphic Lagrangian complex torus S, then its algebraic dimension is n and it has a holomorphic algebraic reduction Z → B which is a Lagrangian fibration with S as a fiber. In particular, this fibration has normal projective base and provides a nontrivial semiample pullback bundle on Z.
